title: David is rejected by the Philistine commanders
description: The Philistine commanders suspect David when they see him marching at the rear with King Achish at Aphek. They demand that he be sent back so that he does not turn against them in battle and regain Saul's favor. Reluctantly, Achish sends David and his men home, while the Philistine army marches up to Jezreel.
